name: dither-image
title: Dither Image
description: A figure that renders an image as a black-and-white Bayer dither, plus a reveal variant where a clean copy is wiped across the dot pattern as the pointer moves.
use: You want a printed, retro dot-screen look, or a playful wipe between colour and dithered versions.
avoid: The dither is grayscale and loses detail, so portraits and small frames turn muddy.
a11y: The partial reveal only responds to pointer movement, so keyboard users see just the default split. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two square photos sit side by side on black. The left pug is fully rendered as a coarse black-and-white dot screen; the right mountain photo mixes clean colour with a dotted patch, split along a soft vertical edge. Tiny grey captions sit below.
behaves: One photo stays fully dithered. Moving the pointer across the second wipes the boundary between the clean image and its dotted copy, and leaving resets it to the middle.
customise: src and alt fill each image; cell size, aspect, grayscale, contrast, brightness, blur, opacity, rounding and mask direction and range are props.
weight: light: Two images with CSS filters and one inline stylesheet; no script loop.
